description: A shell script template for managing a service in a system, including functions for creating configuration files, initializing, starting, stopping the service, and handling various events.

methods.name: create_conf_file
methods.description: Creates a configuration file with static content, demonstrating how to write static text to a file.

methods.name: create_conf_file2
methods.description: Creates a configuration file with interpreted shell variables, showing dynamic content creation.

methods.name: create_conf_file3
methods.description: Creates a configuration file using syscfg values obtained via utctx_cmd, demonstrating fetching and evaluating system configuration variables.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting syscfg values and preparing the environment.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Handles starting the service: waits for end state, sets status, creates config files, and launches service processes.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Handles stopping the service: waits for end state, terminates processes, and resets status.
